Class RetroVaultApp

java.lang.Object
RetroVaultApp
public class RetroVaultApp extends Object
Steven Piskunov CEN-3024C - Software Development I October 30, 2026 RetroVaultApp.java Main controller and console interface for the RetroVault Video Game DMS. This class drives an interactive, crash-proof menu loop allowing users to perform batch ingestion, record creation, searching, updating, deletion, catalog display, and custom financial valuation calculations over video game inventory.
